generator_cmd: perl -e 'print pack("(n/a*)*", $ENV{plain} =~ /\S+\s*/g)' | head -c 60| xxd -p | tr -d '\n'   # env plain=<plain>
oracle_plain: Nice work decoding this warmup! To solve, su
oracle_note: the perl/protobuf reader is lenient (garbage frames or a short read); a decoy = plain text under hex/b64 (owned by those decoders) or frames that do not cover the WHOLE stream
